tools.name: get_filter_options
tools.description: Get every supported search field, defaults, seniority levels, function/industry codes, sorting and pay rules.

tools.name: get_filters
tools.description: Read the connected account’s search, including home and filters. A missing origin means no home has been saved. Requires filters:read.

tools.name: set_filters
tools.description: Save a partial filter change. Omitted fields stay unchanged; empty category strings clear them. Origin is a coordinate pair; home is its display label.

tools.name: resolve_location
tools.description: Resolve a US address or place to candidate coordinates. Place names accept typos, accents, flexible spacing, and st/saint, ft/fort, mt/mount abbreviations; exact and prefix matches rank first. Ambiguous addresses can return multiple candidates.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search the offpeak.fyi public job board; every result has a public job page URL (https://offpeak.fyi/jobs/<id>) with an Apply link to the employer. Anonymous searches require filters.origin as {lat,lng}; filters.home is only a display label. Job keywords include related occupation titles and spellin

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Open the public job page at https://offpeak.fyi/jobs/<id> for an Apply link to the employer. Get current details for a job ID from search results. apply_url is the employer's own application page on its applicant tracking system (Workday, Greenhouse, iCIMS…); source_url is the original posting. Offp

tools.name: get_jobs
tools.description: Each result has a public job page at https://offpeak.fyi/jobs/<id> with an Apply link. Read up to 100 job IDs in caller order, with missing_ids and closed_ids. Full details include apply_url (the employer's application page), source_url and untrusted posting content; summary mode returns compact sav

tools.name: get_commute_time
tools.description: Get the routed driving commute for a job site. Drive times use typical weekday rush-hour traffic. Anonymous callers require origin as {lat,lng}. Connected callers may use a saved origin with filters:read. location_index identifies the matching site in search results.

tools.name: get_saved_jobs
tools.description: List a snapshot of saved job IDs with compact saved_jobs summaries, missing_ids, closed_ids and applied_ids (jobs marked as applied). Pagination accepts cursor=next_cursor and optionally limit; cursors expire after 15 minutes.

tools.name: save_job
tools.description: Save or unsave a job on your connected account.

tools.name: mark_applied
tools.description: Record that the user applied to a job, or clear that mark. Marking also saves the job; clearing keeps it saved. Only call after the user confirms they submitted the application themselves. Offpeak never submits applications.

tools.name: get_saved_searches
tools.description: List your saved searches with their filters and whether email is on. Does not run the searches or return matching jobs.

tools.name: save_search
tools.description: Save a search to your account (up to 50). Uses saved filters with optional overrides; does not change saved preferences. Email is initially off and can be enabled separately. Saving the same search again returns the existing one.

tools.name: update_search
tools.description: Change criteria on an existing saved search in place. Omitted filters stay unchanged. Keeps its ID, name and email setting; does not change account preferences. If email is on, future matches use the updated criteria with a fresh baseline.

tools.name: set_search_email
tools.description: Email new matching jobs for one saved search to your account email, or stop. Up to 20 saved searches can have email on. Email is sent once your account email is verified. Turning email off keeps the saved search.

tools.name: delete_saved_search
tools.description: Delete one of your saved searches and stop its email.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_jobs, get_saved_searches, save_search, update_search, set_search_email, delete_saved_search · Private data: mark_applied · Public sink: get_saved_searches, save_search, update_search, set_search_email, delete_saved_search · Destructive: get_saved_searches, delete_saved_search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_jobs, get_saved_searches, save_search, update_search, set_search_email, delete_saved_search · Private data: mark_applied · Public sink: get_saved_searches, save_search, update_search, set_search_email, delete_saved_search · Destructive: get_saved_searches, delete_saved_search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_filters" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

A missing origin means no home has been saved. Requires filters:read." → after: "Read the connected account’s search, including home and filters. A missing origin means no home has been saved. Requires filters:read."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
